morbi.headline: Mixed week as falling freight and cheaper fuel balance declining tile export projections.
what_changed: Tile export market projections dropped to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following improved propane supply availability.
Ocean container freight rates for Morbi ceramics dropped by up to 50 percent.
Somany Ceramics announced a 5 MSM capacity hike via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports are projected to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for export shipments [d6c30857de2c]
Improved propane supply allowed Morbi ceramic units to cut higher-cost PNG consumption [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Destination-wise export volumes to assess the actual impact of the Rs 12,000-13,000 crore projection.
Propane vs PNG price differentials and fuel substitution levels across MSME ceramic kilns.
Details on Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking plan, including capex, funding mix, and location impact [0f642d309dd8].

surat.headline: Diamond sector recovers with early reopening, while textiles face muted demand and printing cost hikes.
what_changed: Surat diamond units are reducing Diwali breaks and reopening early due to demand recovery after a four-year slump.
Textile industry benefits from a 17% drop in crude oil prices, though overall MMF textile demand remains muted.
Position Printing Association announced a 15% printing charge hike alongside a strict 45-day payment term.
stress_signals: Position Printing Association implemented a 15% rate hike and strict 45-day payment window post-Diwali [ad48975ddfcf].
Textile demand remains muted during the festive season, diverging from diamond sector recovery [d6a824e747af].
Textile traders face ongoing transportation issues, prompting FOSTA discussions for regular parcel trains [d1f9f2e9444f].
improvement_signals: Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore in investment [021c037e28d9].
Diamond units halved Diwali breaks and scheduled early reopenings due to improved demand [5fc0b7b85616, bae3b8d48691, bd78e4a130ff].
Crude oil prices fell 17% in 10 days, easing input costs for Surat's MMF textile sector [71350aa24679].
what_to_watch: Impact of the 15% printing cost hike and 45-day payment deadline on textile units' working capital.
Implementation timeline and compliance requirements for Ministry of Textiles' capacity tracking database.
Fire department compliance during Diwali and FOSTA's resolution on parcel train transportation issues.
